name: The Ace Face

intro.text: They call me the Ace Face. Best suit, best scooter, best dancer on the pier. Forty mirrors on my Lambretta, and I can see you in every one of them.
You want the mods at the rally? You'll have to beat the best of us first. I don't lose, mate. I've never had the time.

win: ...Fair play. That was sharp. Sharper than my lapels.
after: Stay sharp, keep it neat, and never, ever, let a rocker touch your mirrors.
